C3 at Packages/CounterFeature/Sources/CounterCore/CounterFeature.swift:70: Dismiss does not cancel the in-flight fact request, so the fact reappears after dismissal

Failure scenario: State has isLoadingFact = true after .factButtonTapped, and the .run effect at line 49 is waiting on apiClient.randomFact(). .factDismissButtonTapped arrives: lines 68-70 set fact = nil and isLoadingFact = false and return .none, so nothing cancels the effect. When the request finishes, the effect sends .factResponse(text), and lines 58-61 set state.fact = text with no check. The dismissed fact comes back. Because dismiss also sets isLoadingFact = false, the 'Cat fact' button (CounterView.swift:31, .disabled(store.isLoadingFact)) is enabled again, so a second request can start while the first is still running, and the two responses can arrive in either order. If the request fails, .factFailed logs an error for a request the user abandoned.
